sources.title: Web-Based AI System for Detecting Apple Leaf and Fruit Diseases - MDPI
sources.snippet: An important by-product of this research is the creation of a web application, easily accessible using Gradio, to conduct real-time disease detection through the upload of apple fruit and leaf images by users. The app gives predicted disease labels along with confidence values and elaborate information on symptoms and management.
